scripts.build:cloud: cross-env VITE_APP_MODE=cloud tsc && cross-env VITE_APP_MODE=cloud vite build
scripts.build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.electron:dev: npx cross-env VITE_DIRECT_LLM=true vite build && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-electron-pkg.cjs && npx electron electron-dist/main.js
scripts.build:desktop: npx cross-env VITE_DIRECT_LLM=true vite build && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-electron-pkg.cjs && npx electron-builder
scripts.build:win: npx cross-env VITE_DIRECT_LLM=true vite build && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-electron-pkg.cjs && npx electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npx cross-env VITE_DIRECT_LLM=true vite build && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-electron-pkg.cjs && npx electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npx cross-env VITE_DIRECT_LLM=true vite build && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-electron-pkg.cjs && npx electron-builder --linux
